contexts.text: To reason against what is good and true is not to possess what is rational; for many can do this who rush outwardly... into all wickedness.
In the other life... when external bonds are taken away... they rush into all wickedness without shame, fear, or horror. AC 10745, enum.
(The people of Mars) account it wicked to think one thing and say another...
Marriages between those of diverse religion are in Heaven accounted as heinous... and this was why... it was altogether heinous for (the Israelites) to commit whoredom with the gentiles.
Purification from that heinous crime. Signified.
On the malice and wicked arts of infernal Spirits. General article. HH 580, enumerated.
The nefarious arts (of the Babylonians). Signified, Explained.
Nor is it in accordance with justice... for one to take upon himself the wickedness of another, and for the wicked to become innocent; the wickedness being thus washed away.
(Charles XII) then rushed into nefarious things, which are not to be mentioned...
